# Thaumaturgy
Thaumaturgy is the science of understanding the world around us and its secrets, through analysis of the interactions between its basic elements - magical essences.
The work of thaumaturgists is divided into practical and theoretical parts.
## Theoretical thaumaturgy
As you study the world around you, various knowledge about how it works settles in your mind. This knowledge can be spent to uncover new secrets.
The world is full of [bold]Secrets[/bold]. Each secret unlocks new possibilities for players.
Using a research table, you can spend accumulated knowledge to make new discoveries. As a result of your research, you will write a book that holds the secrets you have uncovered. You can let anyone read this book to share the secret you discovered.
Uncovering secrets and building up a library is the main goal of scholars.
## Practical thaumaturgy
Making discoveries requires knowledge of the world around you. It is practical and investigative work that lets you accumulate that knowledge.
Explore the following ways to accumulate knowledge: - [textlink="Research" link="CEThaumaturgyResearchEN"] - [textlink="Infusion altar" link="CEThaumaturgyInfusionAltarEN"] - Even more will appear in the future.
